I'll add one test file, then prove it can fail by temporarily drifting a template.

<edit path="tests/test_issue_templates.py">
import re
from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".github" / "ISSUE_TEMPLATE"
TRIAGE_BLOCK = re.compile(r"<!-- triage: begin -->\n.*?<!-- triage: end -->", re.DOTALL)
EXPECTED_TEMPLATES = {"bug.md", "feature.md", "question.md", "docs.md"}


def test_triage_blocks_are_identical_across_issue_templates():
    templates = sorted(TEMPLATE_DIR.glob("*.md"))
    assert EXPECTED_TEMPLATES <= {t.name for t in templates}

    blocks = {}
    for template in templates:
        match = TRIAGE_BLOCK.search(template.read_text())
        assert match, f"{template.name} has no triage block"
        blocks[template.name] = match.group(0)

    reference = blocks["bug.md"]
    drifted = sorted(name for name, block in blocks.items() if block != reference)
    assert not drifted, f"triage block differs from bug.md in: {drifted}"
</edit>

</command>

<command>

<command>
cp /tmp/docs.md.bak .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/docs.md && cmp /tmp/docs.md.bak .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/docs.md && echo restored
</command>
